failure.symptom: Startup stopped after the GPU limits probe. The renderer never compiled art 1 or logged 'viewer started', so no native window appeared.
failure.mechanism: Stack samples of the hung game process: the bridge's inproc-init thread was suspended (usr1_handler, then wait_suspend) inside NtQueryVolumeInformationFile and virtual_locked_server_call, holding Wine's virtual-memory lock. The game thread then waited on that lock, or spun, indefinitely.
failure.trigger: Rust std exists()/is_dir()/fs::read call GetFileInformationByHandle. Under Wine that is a mountmgr volume ioctl (code 0x6d4084), completed asynchronously by SIGUSR1. Case-insensitive asset path resolution issued about 1,500 of them at startup (1,191 on inproc-init alone, with 74 signals).
failure.not_fixed: The signal arriving inside a section where Wine should block it is a defect of the ARM64 Wine/FEX build. The fix removes the trigger, not that defect.
ruled_out: Preloading: CIV3R_PRELOAD=off hangs the same way.
FEX code cache: FEX_DISKCACHE=0 hangs the same way.
f510 code: the f7b0 release that worked on 21 October hangs the same way now; its IFC23.dll and civ3r_native libraries are byte-identical to f510's.
failure.unexplained: What changed on Neo between the last good run (21 October) and 22 October is unknown.
failure.invalid_attempts: The first launches over SSH could not reach WindowServer (winemac.drv loaded and unloaded) and do not represent the user's launch. All later runs were in the logged-in GUI session.

fix: civ3-assets resolves path components from cached directory listings and reads whole files with files::read_file, which skips the metadata() size hint. Font sheets, BIQ files and the bridge's opacity PCX reads use it.
